build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: Gate D golden of the building's hub from its entrance (I6 step 5, ADR-0014 §3, style 5.2, concept panel 1): the esde/building fixture planned under the shipped threshold, the walker before the closed entrance doors at the hub's east end facing west: the landmark's glowing globe before the elevator's portal and its floor sign, the directory's totem beside it, the favourites' showcase with its proxies' covers and the information screen's edge on the left (south), lit bookcases along both walls under the balcony, its columns and railings, the coffered ceiling with the chandelier's bulbs, the sofas and rugs.

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

fixture.name: esde/building
fixture.rule: SHA-256 of the lines "<relative path>\t<SHA-256 of the file>\n", sorted by path

run.regenerate: $env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1; build/msvc-x64-debug/bin/rv_smoke_tests.exe "golden/G14:*"; Remove-Item Env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN (then run it again without the variable; tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp)
steps: a first run of the same command but --frames 300 and without --video-freeze-pts, --spawn or --input-script: the plan generated and written, the covers into the cache
